purpose: Local-only research assets for Noor development. Files downloaded into .datasets/ are git-ignored and must not be uploaded, served, or added to a model/product without an independent license and DUA review.

datasets.name: UTHealth Endometriosis MRI Dataset
datasets.modality: Pelvic MRI: T1, T1FS, T2, T2FS; NIfTI masks
datasets.commercialUse: Not permitted by the dataset terms: free exclusively for non-commercial scientific research.
datasets.notes: 133 endometriosis MRI cases across two institutions. Labels are uterus, ovaries, endometriomas, cysts, and cul-de-sac—not DIE lesion labels. Do not use to make a DIE-detection claim.

datasets.name: Uterine Myoma MRI Dataset
datasets.modality: Sagittal T2 pelvic MRI; DICOM, NIfTI, and masks
datasets.commercialUse: CC BY 4.0; attribution required. Review any code/checkpoint licenses separately.
datasets.notes: 300 real pelvic MRI cases. Fibroid anatomy only; use for pelvic MRI UI, segmentation, and differential workflows, never to infer endometriosis.

datasets.name: KI EndoLIST
datasets.commercialUse: Not cleared. Follow the PhysioNet DUA exactly.
datasets.notes: Do not automate download. After approval, place downloaded files under the stated local path; do not display raw participant timelines unless explicitly permitted.

datasets.name: GLENDA v1.5
datasets.commercialUse: Scientific research only; contact the video originator for any other purpose.
datasets.notes: Surgical video is not MRI/ultrasound. Keep it as a separate confirmation/research modality.
